body: Sorry for the code churn this naming change will create, but `set_compute()` just feels not descriptive enough. I want to be more clear about what the function is doing

Tested locally on Linux + NVIDIA (with GLCache and Godot shader caches cleared), it works as expected. I don't get a stutter when firing a bullet on the TPS or platformer demos (not any more than in `master`, at least[^1]).

[^1]: In debug builds, there's a significant (15-20 ms) stutter every time I fire a bullet in the TPS demo, but it happens even after the first bullet fired. This doesn't happen in an optimized editor build (`optimize=speed lto=full`).

Looks great! Let's go ahead with this now. 

I do feel like we should eventually add a mechanism to do the free on a background thread. In a perfect world the free function would always return quickly without stalling. 

But this is already a strict improvement, so I think we should merge the PR now while we discuss further improvements

_Edit: I forgot to post the performance numbers earlier. In a large project, Dario and I saw this change reduce load times by about 7 seconds._
